analysis.primary: W2-W4 accuracy percentage points isolates correctness-gated versus ungated anchoring
analysis.secondary: W4-W1 accuracy percentage points contrasts hard-label anchoring with cumulative target memory
analysis.test: Two-sided paired t tests of54 person-level five-seed mean differences,df53; exactly one new2-test Holm family.
analysis.intervals: Pointwise95%t confidence intervals, not Holm-adjusted intervals.
analysis.other_metrics: Descriptive paired NLL,ECE15,Brier,confidence and training-target displacement; no additional significance families.
analysis.probability_mapping: Exact original binary Walsh rows, bit clip1e-7, max-subtracted class log scores followed by normalized exponentials, and final class probability floor1e-12 for old-compatible NLL; new Brier uses full normalized posterior.
analysis.limitation: Lee test results were previously inspected in other studies. This is a prespecified exploratory mechanism ablation, not unused-data validation or a new confirmatory family replacing the old five.
analysis.n: 54 people, not270 new fits or810 combined records. Preserve every person, seed and negative/inconclusive result.

scientific_scope.official_metric_decoder: unchanged original float64 Euclidean decision on saved float32 P

protocol.research_question: Separate anchoring from correctness gating within the same Lee2019 EEGNet, budget, data and output representation.

data_and_information.train: Same retained 100 first-day offline trials per subject,50 left/50 right,62 EEG channels,512 samples,128Hz.
data_and_information.test: Same separate 100 second-day offline trials. Read only after all270 new fits freeze.
data_and_information.normalization: Exact original training100 float64 channel mean/populationSD+1e-6 over trials and time; transformed input float32.
data_and_information.no_new_adaptation: No test statistics, model/seed selection, early stopping, temperature, alignment, transfer or teacher.
data_and_information.historical: Existing W1/W2 540 fit/prediction pairs retained unchanged; not retrained and not extra participants.

training.model: Exact original EEGNet constructor/draw order, temporal8/depthwise16/separable16,256 features,16 sigmoid Walsh bits; dropout0.5.
training.optimizer: Adam0.001, fresh optimizer per model, batch16,2100 actual updates in300 epochs.
training.seed: Original core.set_seed(seed), seed1..5; original torch.Generator(seed) for sample order.
training.phases: 10 consecutive phases of30 epochs. Phase p trains against current targets then predicts training100 and computes alpha=.03*p.
training.last_used: Phase0 update is zero; final trained phase9 uses targets computed after phase8 at alpha=.24. Phase9's alpha=.27 targets are saved but never trained against.
training.W4: ((1-alpha)*hard_codeword + alpha*current_training_prediction).astype(float32) for ALL samples; previous negotiated targets and correctness are not used.
training.W2: Historical anchored correctness-gated recurrence retained exactly.
training.precision: Training gate float32 Euclidean in old W2; original walsh_metrics converts saved float32 prediction tofloat64 before native nearest-codeword decisions.
training.timing: New checkpoint/progress overhead differs; do not claim a controlled speed comparison with historical fits.
training.resume: Same version/identity/input/params plus full model,BN,Adam,negotiated/used targets,global Python/NumPy/Torch/CUDA RNG and generator state at phase boundary only.
